description: This file is a shell script used for testing git submodule fetch behavior, especially focusing on recursive fetch, handling of submodules outside the index, nested submodules, and various configuration overrides. It contains setup routines, test cases, and validation procedures for different scenarios involving git submodules.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Generates expected output regarding fetching a submodule at a specific commit.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Generates expected output for a second submodule's fetch at a specific commit.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Generates expected output for a nested submodule fetch.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Generates expected output for fetching the superproject.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in submodules with specific changes and writes expected output files.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Updates superproject commits, including submodule references, and writes expected output.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies that the actual fetch output matches the expected output by concatenating expected error files and comparing.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Helper to add files, commit, and push in a given repository.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares refs in two directories to verify they point to the same commit.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Performs a fetch with a sed-based recursion detection to prevent infinite recursion.

search-terms: fetch in presence of multiple submodules
fetch --all with nested and conflicting submodules
